DECLARE j JSONB; r JSONB; prior RECORD; src RECORD; first_event RECORD; lock_key BIGINT;
      BEGIN
        lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
        SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.demo_account_current_observations
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
          ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
        SELECT * INTO src FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND sequence=NEW.source_sequence;
        SELECT * INTO first_event FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND sequence=1;
        -- Never accept a caller timestamp, including one supplied despite the
        -- column default. This time is a DB receipt, not a host-clock claim.
        NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
        j := NEW.document_json::jsonb; r := NEW.receipt_json::jsonb;
        IF src.sequence IS NULL
          OR first_event.sequence IS NULL
          OR ROW(src.environment,src.account_id,src.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR ROW(first_event.environment,first_event.account_id,first_event.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR first_event.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'capture_start'
          OR first_event.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'contract_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_current_account_plan.v7'
          OR src.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
          OR src.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
          OR NEW.db_recorded_at < src.db_recorded_at
          OR (prior.sequence IS NOT NULL AND NEW.db_recorded_at < prior.db_recorded_at)
          OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_current_observation.v1'
          OR j->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c7ed2206012e125a10e06283c98a1edc5c9a0dbf1add662be15f0f18952fa631'
          OR j->>'current_source_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c2a01ced25dfd1fd12aebd784b28c7bdb334694ef2c19212e0c9d2ae3af24999'
          OR r->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.current_account_source_observation.v6'
          OR r->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c2a01ced25dfd1fd12aebd784b28c7bdb334694ef2c19212e0c9d2ae3af24999'
          OR r->>'effective_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c2a01ced25dfd1fd12aebd784b28c7bdb334694ef2c19212e0c9d2ae3af24999'
          OR j->'source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM r->'source_reference'
          OR j->'source_reference'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.capture_id
          OR j->'source_reference'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM src.event_sha256
          OR j->'source_reference'->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM first_event.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'plan_sha256'
          OR j->'source_reference'->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM first_event.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256'
          OR j->>'scope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'scope_sha256'
          OR r->'identity'->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR r->'identity'->>'uid' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR r->'identity'->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR j->>'validated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM r->'observation_interval'->>'validated_at'
          OR r->'algo_type_coverage'->'all_eight_terminal_chains_replayed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
          OR jsonb_typeof(r->'algo_type_coverage'->'terminal_receipt_sha256s') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(r->'algo_type_coverage'->'terminal_receipt_sha256s')) IS DISTINCT FROM 8::bigint
          OR j->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'flat_start_permission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR r->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->'flat_start_permission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR (j->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sequence
          OR j->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_sha256
          OR j->>'receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.receipt_json,'UTF8')),'hex')
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.document_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_sha256
          OR NEW.sequence <> COALESCE(prior.sequence,0)+1
          OR NEW.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM prior.event_sha256 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_current_observation_append_denied';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;

DECLARE j JSONB;
      BEGIN
        NEW.db_claimed_at := clock_timestamp();
        j := NEW.claim_json::jsonb;
        IF encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.claim_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claim_sha256
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(j)) IS DISTINCT FROM 21::bigint
          OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.g12.invocation_claim.v1'
          OR j->>'invocation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.invocation_id
          OR j->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR j->>'account_uid_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_uid_sha256
          OR j->>'event_key' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_key
          OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR j->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->>'report_id' IS NULL OR j->>'instrument_id' IS NULL
          OR COALESCE(j->>'direction','') NOT IN ('long','short')
          OR j->>'entry' IS NULL OR j->>'stop_loss' IS NULL OR j->>'take_profit' IS NULL
          OR j->>'deadline' IS NULL
          OR COALESCE(j->>'account_plan_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->>'candidate_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->>'original_run_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->>'original_market_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->>'original_inputs_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->>'evidence_root_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR (j->>'deadline')::timestamptz <= NEW.db_claimed_at THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'g12_claim_denied';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;

DECLARE j JSONB; r JSONB; a JSONB; prior RECORD; src RECORD;
              lock_key BIGINT; prefix TEXT; maximum BIGINT; scope_hash TEXT;
      BEGIN
        lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
        SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.demo_account_observation_typed_batches
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
          ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
        SELECT * INTO src FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND sequence=NEW.source_sequence
          FOR KEY SHARE;
        NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
        j := NEW.document_json::jsonb;
        r := NEW.receipt_json::jsonb;
        scope_hash := encode(sha256(convert_to('["'||NEW.environment||'","'||NEW.account_id||'","'||NEW.settlement_currency||'"]','UTF8')),'hex');
        IF jsonb_typeof(j) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR jsonb_typeof(r) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR src.sequence IS NULL
          OR ROW(src.environment,src.account_id,src.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR src.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
          OR src.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
          OR NEW.db_recorded_at < src.db_recorded_at
          OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_observation_typed_batch.v1'
          OR r->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.observed_account_execution_window.v3'
          OR j->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'd4e9a8e4fea2de6d4b534c7be4d3ab5e3713409dd22640f6adbca5e2e483cd8e'
          OR j->>'persistence_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'd4e9a8e4fea2de6d4b534c7be4d3ab5e3713409dd22640f6adbca5e2e483cd8e'
          OR j->>'typed_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '959fb552875d01b06fdd0545dc914a4fa36a880320c7c6ce8bc796e6ffdcdb21'
          OR r->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '959fb552875d01b06fdd0545dc914a4fa36a880320c7c6ce8bc796e6ffdcdb21'
          OR j->>'scope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM scope_hash
          OR r->>'scope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM scope_hash
          OR j->'reference'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.capture_id
          OR j->'reference'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM src.event_sha256
          OR COALESCE(j->'reference'->>'plan_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->'reference'->>'packet_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR COALESCE(j->'reference'->>'session_binding_sha256','') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR (j->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sequence
          OR j->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_sha256
          OR j->>'receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.receipt_json,'UTF8')),'hex')
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.document_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_sha256
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'window') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR j->'window' IS DISTINCT FROM r->'window'
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'window'->'started_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'window'->'ended_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR (j->'window'->>'started_at')::timestamptz > (j->'window'->>'ended_at')::timestamptz
          OR (j->'window'->>'ended_at')::timestamptz - (j->'window'->>'started_at')::timestamptz > interval '7 days'
          OR j->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR r->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR r->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'anchor_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof((j->>'anchor_json')::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR (j->>'anchor_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM r->'continuation_anchor'
          OR j->>'anchor_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(j->>'anchor_json','UTF8')),'hex')
          OR NEW.sequence <> COALESCE(prior.sequence,0)+1
          OR NEW.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM prior.event_sha256 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_observation_typed_append_denied';
        END IF;
        a := r->'continuation_anchor';
        IF a->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_observation_typed_continuation.v1'
          OR a->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'd4e9a8e4fea2de6d4b534c7be4d3ab5e3713409dd22640f6adbca5e2e483cd8e'
          OR a->>'typed_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '959fb552875d01b06fdd0545dc914a4fa36a880320c7c6ce8bc796e6ffdcdb21'
          OR a->>'scope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM scope_hash
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'through_sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR (a->>'through_sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sequence
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'previous_sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR (a->>'previous_sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sequence-1
          OR a->>'previous_event_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_sha256
          OR a->>'current_source_membership_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM j->>'source_membership_sha256'
          OR a->>'current_coverage_membership_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM j->>'coverage_membership_sha256'
          OR a->>'previous_anchor_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM
             (CASE WHEN prior.sequence IS NULL THEN NULL
                   ELSE prior.document_json::jsonb->>'anchor_sha256' END)
          OR (prior.sequence IS NOT NULL AND
              (prior.document_json::jsonb->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'd4e9a8e4fea2de6d4b534c7be4d3ab5e3713409dd22640f6adbca5e2e483cd8e'
               OR prior.document_json::jsonb->>'typed_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '959fb552875d01b06fdd0545dc914a4fa36a880320c7c6ce8bc796e6ffdcdb21'))
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'verified_witnesses') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'required_proof_budget_exceeded') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'source_facts_through_sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'coverage_through_sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR jsonb_typeof(a->'unresolved_findings_through_sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_observation_typed_anchor_denied';
        END IF;
        FOR prefix, maximum IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
          ('source',16384::bigint),('coverage',128::bigint),('finding',16384::bigint)
        ) AS limits(prefix,maximum) LOOP
          IF jsonb_typeof(j->(prefix||'_membership_count')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR NOT COALESCE(j->>(prefix||'_membership_count') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$',false)
            OR (j->>(prefix||'_membership_count'))::bigint NOT BETWEEN 0 AND maximum
            OR NOT COALESCE(j->>(prefix||'_membership_sha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$',false) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_observation_typed_membership_shape_denied';
          END IF;
        END LOOP;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;

DECLARE j JSONB; prior RECORD; lock_key BIGINT; expected_id TEXT;
      BEGIN
        lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(
          convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
        SELECT sequence,event_sha256,db_recorded_at INTO prior
          FROM public.demo_event_history_epoch_events WHERE epoch_id=NEW.epoch_id
          ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
        NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
        expected_id := encode(sha256(
          convert_to('ctcc-demo-event-history-epoch-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.credential_session_binding_sha256,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.claimed_source_sha256,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          convert_to(NEW.policy_sha256,'UTF8')),'hex');
        j := NEW.event_json::jsonb;
        IF NEW.epoch_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_id
          OR NEW.sequence IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(prior.sequence,0)+1
          OR NEW.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM prior.event_sha256
          OR (prior.sequence IS NOT NULL AND NEW.db_recorded_at < prior.db_recorded_at)
          OR jsonb_typeof(j) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(j)) IS DISTINCT FROM 16::bigint
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_sha256
          OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_event_history_epoch_event.v1'
          OR j->>'epoch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.epoch_id
          OR jsonb_typeof(j->'sequence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
          OR (j->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sequence
          OR j->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR j->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR j->>'credential_session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.credential_session_binding_sha256
          OR j->>'claimed_source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claimed_source_sha256
          OR j->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_sha256
          OR j->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kind
          OR j->>'reason_code' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.reason_code
          OR j->>'evidence_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.evidence_sha256
          OR j->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_sha256
          OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR j->'history_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'demo_event_history_epoch_append_denied';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;

DECLARE a RECORD; h RECORD; c RECORD; hf RECORD; cf RECORD;
              b RECORD; v RECORD; j JSONB; q JSONB; lock_key BIGINT;
      BEGIN
        lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
        SELECT * INTO a FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
        SELECT * INTO h FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.history_capture_id
            AND sequence=NEW.history_terminal_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id
            AND sequence=NEW.current_terminal_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO hf FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.history_capture_id AND sequence=1 FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO cf FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=1 FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO b FROM public.demo_account_observation_typed_batches
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
            AND sequence=NEW.typed_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO v FROM public.demo_account_current_observations
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
            AND sequence=NEW.current_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
        BEGIN
          j := NEW.witness_json::jsonb;
          q := NEW.claims_json::jsonb;
        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_revision_witness_document_invalid';
        END;
        IF a.account_revision IS NULL
          OR a.account_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_revision
          OR a.ledger_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.ledger_revision
          OR a.claims_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
          OR a.claims_json IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_json
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(a.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex')
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
          OR q->'scope'->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR q->'scope'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'scope'->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR q->'account'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'account'->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR q->'authority'->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR q->'account'->'balance_stamp'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'account'->'positions_stamp'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'account'->'history_stamp'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'account'->'reservations_stamp'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR q->'authority'->'stamp'->>'account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR h.sequence IS NULL OR c.sequence IS NULL
          OR hf.sequence IS NULL OR cf.sequence IS NULL
          OR b.sequence IS NULL OR v.sequence IS NULL
          OR ROW(h.environment,h.account_id,h.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR ROW(c.environment,c.account_id,c.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR ROW(hf.environment,hf.account_id,hf.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR ROW(cf.environment,cf.account_id,cf.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR h.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.history_head_sha256
          OR c.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
          OR b.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.typed_head_sha256
          OR v.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_index_sha256
          OR b.capture_id IS DISTINCT FROM h.capture_id
          OR b.source_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM h.sequence
          OR v.capture_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.capture_id
          OR v.source_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM c.sequence
          OR h.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
          OR c.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
          OR h.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
          OR c.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'contract_version'
             IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_account_plan.v5'
          OR cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'contract_version'
             IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_current_account_plan.v7'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'environment'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'environment'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'expected_uid'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'expected_uid'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'settlement_currency'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'settlement_currency'
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'expected_main_uid'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'expected_main_uid'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'session_binding_id'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'session_binding_id'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region'
          OR COALESCE(hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region','')
             NOT IN ('global','us_au','eea','tr')
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'origin'
             IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region'
               WHEN 'global' THEN 'https://openapi.okx.com'
               WHEN 'us_au' THEN 'https://us.okx.com'
               WHEN 'eea' THEN 'https://eea.okx.com'
               WHEN 'tr' THEN 'https://tr.okx.com'
             END)
          OR cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region'
             IS DISTINCT FROM hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_region'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_evidence_sha256'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'registration_evidence_sha256'
          OR hf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'origin'
             IS DISTINCT FROM cf.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'origin'
          OR h.db_recorded_at >= cf.db_recorded_at
          OR b.db_recorded_at < h.db_recorded_at
          OR v.db_recorded_at < c.db_recorded_at
          OR j IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(j) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_account_revision_source_witness.v1'
          OR j->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR j->'account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.account_revision)
          OR j->'ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.ledger_revision)
          OR j->>'claims_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
          OR j->'history'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.history_capture_id
          OR j->'history'->'terminal_sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.history_terminal_sequence)
          OR j->'history'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.history_head_sha256
          OR j->'history'->'typed_sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.typed_sequence)
          OR j->'history'->>'typed_head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.typed_head_sha256
          OR j->'current'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_capture_id
          OR j->'current'->'terminal_sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.current_terminal_sequence)
          OR j->'current'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
          OR j->'current'->'index_sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.current_sequence)
          OR j->'current'->>'index_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_index_sha256
          OR j->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'source_authenticity_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
          OR j->'blocking_reasons' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(
               'account_revision_is_caller_claim_not_collector_issued',
               'complete_portfolio_snapshot_unavailable',
               'funding_accrual_and_complete_history_unproven',
               'native_clock_and_credential_session_unverified',
               'registered_region_unverified',
               'risk_reservation_and_execution_recheck_unperformed'
             )
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.witness_json,'UTF8')),'hex')
             IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.witness_sha256 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_revision_witness_binding_denied';
        END IF;
        NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
        RETURN NEW;
      END;

DECLARE b RECORD; source RECORD; packet_source RECORD;
              prior RECORD; genesis RECORD; peak RECORD;
              m JSONB; p JSONB; oldp JSONB; g JSONB; selected JSONB;
              packet JSONB; balance_page JSONB; balance_row JSONB;
              config_page JSONB; config_row JSONB;
              packet_count BIGINT; balance_count BIGINT; balance_index BIGINT;
              config_count BIGINT; finalized_count BIGINT; observed_native BOOLEAN;
              lock_key BIGINT; member TEXT; expected_membership TEXT;
              old_num NUMERIC; old_den NUMERIC; new_num NUMERIC; new_den NUMERIC;
              avail_num NUMERIC; avail_den NUMERIC;
              gcd_left NUMERIC; gcd_right NUMERIC; gcd_remainder NUMERIC;
              expected_peak BIGINT; expected_native BOOLEAN;
              expected_genesis_sha256 TEXT; expected_peak_sha256 TEXT;
              projection_keys TEXT[] := ARRAY[
                'account_complete','account_id','admission',
                'all_sources_recorded_native','durable_membership_verified',
                'environment','execution_authority','genesis_measurement_sha256',
                'genesis_source_reference','head_sha256','last_measured_at',
                'last_measurement_sha256','last_source_reference',
                'membership_sha256','native_clock_verified','peak_equity',
                'peak_measurement_sha256','peak_observed_at','peak_source_reference',
                'policy_sha256','previous_head_sha256',
                'previous_projection_sha256','sample_count','schema_version',
                'settlement_currency','through_sequence',
                'unsampled_intermediate_peak','window_started_at'];
      BEGIN
        lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
        SELECT * INTO b FROM public.demo_account_observation_batches
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency AND sequence=NEW.sequence
          FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO source FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND sequence=NEW.source_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT count(*) INTO packet_count FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND packet_payload IS NOT NULL;
        SELECT * INTO packet_source FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
          WHERE capture_id=NEW.capture_id AND packet_payload IS NOT NULL FOR KEY SHARE;
        SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.demo_account_measured_hwm_v2
          WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
            AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
          ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1 FOR KEY SHARE;
        BEGIN
          m := NEW.measurement_json::jsonb;
          p := NEW.projection_json::jsonb;
          oldp := prior.projection_json::jsonb;
          packet := convert_from(packet_source.packet_payload,'UTF8')::jsonb;
          SELECT count(*) INTO balance_count
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(packet->'observations') AS o(value)
            WHERE o.value->'request'->>'stream'='balance';
          SELECT o.value,o.ordinality-1 INTO balance_page,balance_index
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(packet->'observations')
              WITH ORDINALITY AS o(value,ordinality)
            WHERE o.value->'request'->>'stream'='balance' LIMIT 1;
          balance_row := (balance_page->'rows'->0->>'canonical_json')::jsonb;
          SELECT count(*) INTO config_count
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(packet->'observations') AS o(value)
            WHERE o.value->'request'->>'stream'='config_after';
          SELECT o.value INTO config_page
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(packet->'observations') AS o(value)
            WHERE o.value->'request'->>'stream'='config_after' LIMIT 1;
          config_row := (config_page->'rows'->0->>'canonical_json')::jsonb;
          SELECT count(*),bool_and(
            e.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'tls_provenance'='owned_signed_verified_tls'
            AND COALESCE(e.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'tls_certificate_sha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$',false))
            INTO finalized_count,observed_native
            FROM public.demo_account_capture_events AS e
            WHERE e.capture_id=NEW.capture_id
              AND e.event_json::jsonb->>'kind'='raw_finalized';
        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_document_invalid';
        END;
        IF b.sequence IS NULL OR source.sequence IS NULL
          OR packet_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1::bigint
          OR packet_source.sequence IS NULL
          OR packet_source.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'packet_recorded'
          OR ROW(packet_source.environment,packet_source.account_id,packet_source.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR encode(sha256(packet_source.packet_payload),'hex')
             IS DISTINCT FROM b.document_json::jsonb->'reference'->>'packet_sha256'
          OR packet->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.document_json::jsonb->'reference'->>'plan_sha256'
          OR packet->'plan'->>'expected_uid' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR packet->'plan'->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR packet->'plan'->>'registration_region' IS DISTINCT FROM 'global'
          OR balance_page->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo'
          OR packet->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR packet->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR balance_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1::bigint
          OR config_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1::bigint
          OR jsonb_typeof(config_page->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(config_page->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 1
          OR config_row->>'acctLv' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'
          OR config_row->>'uid' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id
          OR config_row->>'mainUid' IS DISTINCT FROM m->>'main_uid'
          OR finalized_count IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(packet->'observations')::bigint
          OR m->'recorded_native_transport' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(COALESCE(observed_native,false))
          OR jsonb_typeof(balance_page->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(balance_page->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 1
          OR jsonb_typeof(balance_row) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR ROW(b.capture_id,b.source_sequence,b.event_sha256,b.previous_sha256)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.capture_id,NEW.source_sequence,NEW.event_sha256,NEW.previous_event_sha256)
          OR ROW(source.environment,source.account_id,source.settlement_currency)
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR source.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM b.document_json::jsonb->'reference'->>'head_sha256'
          OR source.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
          OR source.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
          OR b.db_recorded_at < source.db_recorded_at
          OR NEW.sequence IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(prior.sequence,0)+1
          OR NEW.previous_projection_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM prior.projection_sha256
          OR NEW.previous_event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM prior.event_sha256
          OR NEW.genesis_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM 1::bigint
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.measurement_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.measurement_sha256
          OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.projection_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.projection_sha256
          OR jsonb_typeof(m) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          -- The shared Gate 3 serializer is proved only for ASCII JSON.
          -- B5 is diagnostic: a non-ASCII source fails closed, never gets an
          -- alternate lossy encoding or a newly inferred balance.
          OR public.gate3_schedule_all_ascii(m) IS DISTINCT FROM true
          OR public.gate3_schedule_all_ascii(p) IS DISTINCT FROM true
          OR NEW.measurement_json IS DISTINCT FROM
             public.gate3_schedule_canonical_jsonb(m)
          OR NEW.projection_json IS DISTINCT FROM
             public.gate3_schedule_canonical_jsonb(p)
          OR (p ?& projection_keys) IS DISTINCT FROM true
          OR (p - projection_keys) IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
          OR m->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.measured_balance.v1'
          OR m->'source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM b.document_json::jsonb->'reference'
          OR ROW(m->>'environment',m->>'account_id',m->>'settlement_currency')
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR m->'current_source_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR m IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
               'schema_version','ctcc.measured_balance.v1',
               'source_reference',b.document_json::jsonb->'reference',
               'environment',NEW.environment,'account_id',NEW.account_id,
               'main_uid',config_row->>'mainUid',
               'settlement_currency',NEW.settlement_currency,
               'equity',m->'equity','available_margin',m->'available_margin',
               'request_index',balance_index,'row_ordinal',0,
               'raw_row_sha256',m->>'raw_row_sha256',
               'raw_row_json',balance_page->'rows'->0->>'canonical_json',
               'page_receipt_sha256',balance_page->>'receipt_sha256',
               'body_sha256',balance_page->>'body_sha256',
               'request_started_at',balance_page->>'request_started_at',
               'headers_received_at',balance_page->>'headers_received_at',
               'body_completed_at',balance_page->>'body_completed_at',
               'account_uTime',balance_row->>'uTime',
               'settlement_uTime',balance_row->'details'->0->>'uTime',
               'recorded_native_transport',COALESCE(observed_native,false),
               'current_source_authority',false)
          OR m->'request_index' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(balance_index)
          OR m->'row_ordinal' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
          OR m->>'raw_row_json' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->'rows'->0->>'canonical_json'
          OR m->>'page_receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->>'receipt_sha256'
          OR m->>'body_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->>'body_sha256'
          OR m->>'request_started_at' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->>'request_started_at'
          OR m->>'headers_received_at' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->>'headers_received_at'
          OR m->>'body_completed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_page->>'body_completed_at'
          OR m->>'account_uTime' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_row->>'uTime'
          OR m->>'settlement_uTime' IS DISTINCT FROM balance_row->'details'->0->>'uTime'
          OR jsonb_typeof(balance_row->'details') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(balance_row->'details') IS DISTINCT FROM 1
          OR balance_row->'details'->0->>'ccy' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settlement_currency
          OR (balance_row->'details'->0->>'liab')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric
          OR (balance_row->'details'->0->>'borrowFroz')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'raw_row_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR COALESCE(m->>'raw_row_sha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$',false) IS NOT TRUE
          OR m->>'raw_row_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(m->>'raw_row_json','UTF8')),'hex')
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'recorded_native_transport') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'equity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR m->'equity' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
               'numerator',m->'equity'->>'numerator',
               'denominator',m->'equity'->>'denominator')
          OR COALESCE(m->'equity'->>'numerator' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$',false) IS NOT TRUE
          OR COALESCE(m->'equity'->>'denominator' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$',false) IS NOT TRUE
          OR length(m->'equity'->>'numerator') > 64
          OR length(m->'equity'->>'denominator') > 64
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'available_margin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
          OR m->'available_margin' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
               'numerator',m->'available_margin'->>'numerator',
               'denominator',m->'available_margin'->>'denominator')
          OR COALESCE(m->'available_margin'->>'numerator' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$',false) IS NOT TRUE
          OR COALESCE(m->'available_margin'->>'denominator' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$',false) IS NOT TRUE
          OR length(m->'available_margin'->>'numerator') > 64
          OR length(m->'available_margin'->>'denominator') > 64
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'request_started_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'headers_received_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(m->'body_completed_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
          OR p->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.measured_balance_hwm_continuation.v2'
          OR p->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '8098bda7733ab7c3e3e814768af7591ad6da8caf605d82b000224f54a2e1c5f0'
          OR ROW(p->>'environment',p->>'account_id',p->>'settlement_currency')
             IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          OR p->'sample_count' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.sequence)
          OR p->'through_sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.sequence)
          OR p->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_sha256
          OR p->>'previous_head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_event_sha256
          OR p->>'previous_projection_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_projection_sha256
          OR p->>'last_measurement_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.measurement_sha256
          OR p->'last_source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM m->'source_reference'
          OR jsonb_typeof(p->'all_sources_recorded_native') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
          OR p->'unsampled_intermediate_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM '"unknown"'::jsonb
          OR p->'durable_membership_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR p->'native_clock_verified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR p->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR p->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
          OR p->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_binding_denied';
        END IF;
        new_num := (m->'equity'->>'numerator')::numeric;
        new_den := (m->'equity'->>'denominator')::numeric;
        avail_num := (m->'available_margin'->>'numerator')::numeric;
        avail_den := (m->'available_margin'->>'denominator')::numeric;
        IF new_num <= 0 OR new_den <= 0 OR avail_num < 0 OR avail_den <= 0
          OR new_num IS DISTINCT FROM (balance_row->'details'->0->>'eq')::numeric*new_den
          OR avail_num IS DISTINCT FROM (balance_row->'details'->0->>'availEq')::numeric*avail_den
          OR avail_num*new_den > new_num*avail_den THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_equity_denied';
        END IF;
        gcd_left := new_num; gcd_right := new_den;
        WHILE gcd_right <> 0 LOOP
          gcd_remainder := mod(gcd_left,gcd_right);
          gcd_left := gcd_right; gcd_right := gcd_remainder;
        END LOOP;
        IF gcd_left IS DISTINCT FROM 1::numeric THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_equity_denied';
        END IF;
        gcd_left := avail_num; gcd_right := avail_den;
        WHILE gcd_right <> 0 LOOP
          gcd_remainder := mod(gcd_left,gcd_right);
          gcd_left := gcd_right; gcd_right := gcd_remainder;
        END LOOP;
        IF gcd_left IS DISTINCT FROM 1::numeric THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_available_denied';
        END IF;
        IF prior.sequence IS NULL THEN
          g := m; selected := m;
          expected_peak := NEW.sequence;
          expected_genesis_sha256 := NEW.measurement_sha256;
          expected_peak_sha256 := NEW.measurement_sha256;
          expected_native := (m->>'recorded_native_transport')::boolean;
        ELSE
          SELECT * INTO genesis FROM public.demo_account_measured_hwm_v2
            WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
              AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency AND sequence=1 FOR KEY SHARE;
          SELECT * INTO peak FROM public.demo_account_measured_hwm_v2
            WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
              AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency AND sequence=prior.peak_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
          IF genesis.sequence IS NULL OR peak.sequence IS NULL
            OR oldp->>'membership_sha256' IS NULL
            OR oldp->'genesis_source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM genesis.measurement_json::jsonb->'source_reference'
            OR oldp->>'genesis_measurement_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM genesis.measurement_sha256
            OR oldp->'peak_source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM peak.measurement_json::jsonb->'source_reference'
            OR oldp->>'peak_measurement_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM peak.measurement_sha256 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_prior_witness_denied';
          END IF;
          g := genesis.measurement_json::jsonb;
          expected_genesis_sha256 := genesis.measurement_sha256;
          old_num := (peak.measurement_json::jsonb->'equity'->>'numerator')::numeric;
          old_den := (peak.measurement_json::jsonb->'equity'->>'denominator')::numeric;
          IF old_den <= 0 OR old_num <= 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_equity_denied';
          END IF;
          expected_peak := CASE WHEN new_num*old_den > old_num*new_den
                                THEN NEW.sequence ELSE prior.peak_sequence END;
          selected := CASE WHEN expected_peak=NEW.sequence THEN m
                           ELSE peak.measurement_json::jsonb END;
          expected_peak_sha256 := CASE WHEN expected_peak=NEW.sequence
            THEN NEW.measurement_sha256 ELSE peak.measurement_sha256 END;
          expected_native := (oldp->>'all_sources_recorded_native')::boolean
                             AND (m->>'recorded_native_transport')::boolean;
        END IF;
        IF NEW.peak_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM expected_peak
          OR p->>'genesis_measurement_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM
             expected_genesis_sha256
          OR p->'genesis_source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM g->'source_reference'
          OR p->>'window_started_at' IS DISTINCT FROM g->>'body_completed_at'
          OR p->>'peak_measurement_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM
             expected_peak_sha256
          OR p->'peak_source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->'source_reference'
          OR p->>'peak_observed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'body_completed_at'
          OR p->'peak_equity' IS DISTINCT FROM selected->'equity'
          OR p->>'last_measured_at' IS DISTINCT FROM m->>'body_completed_at'
          OR p->'all_sources_recorded_native' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(expected_native)
          OR (prior.sequence IS NOT NULL AND
              (m->>'body_completed_at')::timestamptz < (oldp->>'last_measured_at')::timestamptz)
          OR (m->>'request_started_at')::timestamptz > (m->>'headers_received_at')::timestamptz
          OR (m->>'headers_received_at')::timestamptz > (m->>'body_completed_at')::timestamptz THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_selected_peak_denied';
        END IF;
        member := '['||NEW.sequence::text||','||
          COALESCE('"'||NEW.previous_event_sha256||'"','null')||',"'||
          NEW.event_sha256||'","'||NEW.measurement_sha256||'"]';
        expected_membership := encode(sha256(
          convert_to('ctcc.measured_balance_hwm_continuation.v2','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
          CASE WHEN prior.sequence IS NULL THEN ''::bytea
               ELSE decode(oldp->>'membership_sha256','hex') END||
          convert_to(member,'UTF8')),'hex');
        IF p->>'membership_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_membership THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_measured_hwm_v2_membership_denied';
        END IF;
        NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
        RETURN NEW;
      END;
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime_bundle_immutable'; END;

  WHERE bundle_id=p_bundle_id AND p_bundle_id ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$';

DECLARE
  head_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  current_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  witness_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  terminal public.demo_account_capture_events%ROWTYPE;
  d jsonb; r jsonb; a jsonb; w jsonb; wd jsonb; ref jsonb; measure record;
  sd jsonb; descriptor jsonb; reference_key text;
  descriptor_sequence bigint; descriptor_source_sequence bigint;
  descriptor_capture text; descriptor_event text;
  source_catalog jsonb; original_source_catalog jsonb;
  sources jsonb[] := ARRAY[]::jsonb[];
  chains jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  wire_rows jsonb; output jsonb;
  member_text text; checkpoint_text text; member_hash text; checkpoint_hash text;
  prior_sequence bigint := 0; witness_sequence bigint;

      WHERE (x->>'table_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass('public.'||(x->>'table'))
